title: Introduction to Point of View (POV)
use_cases: Use when establishing the narrative framework of a story
Implement when defining the scope of information available to the reader
Configure when shaping the emotional resonance of a narrative
Use when determining the primary perspective of a fictional world
content:
Definition

> The perspective from which a story is told.

Why POV Matters

- Shapes the reader’s emotional connection, information access, and narrative tone.
- Determines how much of the world the audience sees and feels.
